cc:Work.dc:title: Primary B5 notification allocation
cc:Work.dc:description: Primary daily budget B=5. Rows: Euler core and Beanstalk Diamond. Left: daily notification counts. Right: notification counts by UTC hour summed over the thirty-day window. Greedy, paced cumulative and single-token policies use identical source events and raw triggers.
